messages:
maya: Heads-up — promo for v1.14.2 is blocked by CI failure. deploy-bot shows artifact verification mismatch for infra-lib submodule. can we triage?

deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion attempt 2024-06-15T14:53Z failed.
Error: artifact digest mismatch for infra-lib
expected: sha256:111aaaa222bbb333ccc444ddd555eee666fff777ggg
got:      sha256:999xxx888yyy777zzz666qqq555rrr444sss333ttt
Action: promotion halted, manual review required.

maya: logs look like the infra-lib commit on the release branch doesn't match the published artifact. who touched submodules recently?

tom: I bumped infra-lib in main yesterday for the config toggle. forgot to update the release branch submodule ref. appears release branch still points at older commit.

jen: OK — two options: 1) pin release to last-green infra-lib commit and re-run CI, or 2) revert the infra-lib bump on main and republish. pinning is faster for this cut.

ravi: Agree pin. The build artifacts were published from infra-lib@abcdef1 (last green). The release branch currently references infra-lib@fedcba9 which has a different build output (hence digest mismatch).

maya: Who can push the pin and trigger a new canary? small checklist: update submodule -> bump in release branch -> push -> trigger CI -> confirm artifact digest matches.

tom: I can do the pin. plan:
```\ngit checkout release/v1.14
git submodule update --init infra-lib
cd infra-lib && git fetch origin && git checkout abcdef1
cd ..
git add infra-lib && git commit -m "pin infra-lib to abcdef1 (last green) for v1.14.2 cut"
git push origin release/v1.14
```

jen: After push, please tag me. I'll re-run the release pipeline (deploy-bot promote) and watch the artifact digest step. If it still fails we revert to manual artifact copy.

deploy-bot: Note: promotes are rate-limited during the change window (14:00-18:00 UTC). This is currently inside the window — canary will run but full cut waits for manual approval.

ravi: Also adding: update release notes with an item about pinning infra-lib and callout in the changelog so SRE knows this is intentional.

maya: If tom can push within 10m we should get a green canary before the change window ends. If not, we'll hold the cut until tomorrow morning. No one wants a mid-window rollback.

tom: pushed -> https://git.internal/redwood/eng/releases/commit/sha/175555abcde
jen: kicked off promote job (deploy-bot trigger) -> watching logs.

deploy-bot: promote started. canary job id: canary-2024-06-15-1755. Running artifact-verify step.

deploy-bot: [artifact-verify] infra-lib digest match: expected sha256:111aaaa222bbb333ccc444ddd555eee666fff777ggg OK

jen: canary passed tests, all e2e smoke green. recommending promote to staging then production.

maya: decision: proceed with staged promote. I'm leaving a manual hold flag until we confirm no downstream cache inconsistencies. If anything flaky appears, we roll back to last-promoted image and open incident.

ravi: quick note for postmortem: add a CI guard that fails merges to release branches when submodule refs diverge from published artifact digest OR require a submodule-ref-update checklist.

maya: thanks everyone. updating release notes + adding a short blurb in the cut ticket about the pin and why. closing this thread when production promote finishes. :thumbsup:

jen: prod promote finished at 15:12 UTC. all good. marking release cut as complete and noting the manual pin in the release notes.

maya: closing — hold reason: resolved.
